name: Shadowbrook
source:
Shadowbrook is the perfect place to settle down, disappear, and forget...

Whether you're just passing through or planning to stay forever, we think you’ll find exactly what you’re looking for here.

Come home to Shadowbrook. We’ve been waiting.

[From [url=https://brooks8.itch.io/shadowbrookvn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Shadowbrook是一个完美的地方，可以让你安定下来、消失、忘记……

无论你只是路过还是打算永远停留，我们相信你都会在这里找到你想要的东西。

回到影子布鲁克的家吧。我们一直在等待。

[来自[url=https://brooks8.itch.io/shadowbrookvn]Itch.io[/url]]
